During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''bombarded''' the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ralgos]].

==The bombardment==
At some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around [[Ralgos]] and began [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarding]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], destroying numerous [[City/Legends|cities]] in the process.<ref name="OAA" />

[[Danel Qurno]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Police officer/Legends|lawman]] in the town of [[Davoras]], witnessed the devastation inflicted upon his world, unable to do anything but to stand and watch. Though he never found what the Imperials were even after in their destruction, this event caused him to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="OAA" />
